method: All 256 native byte mappings, including default substitutions, are compared. Shape removes translation; placed ink uses native bearing and y=row-baseline; advance uses kern+space for proportional fonts and nominal width for monospaced fonts. YAFF reconstruction is verified against actual compiled FNV-1a-64 hashes for all 39 built-ins. SPF coverage is ASCII 32..126 only; SPF placed ink assumes left alignment because SPF2 carries no bearing field, and is not a claim about RGTerm rendering.
